description: Department of Local Government - Central Province - The Drinking Water Safety by - Laws of the Na-Ula Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette notification announces the enactment of "Drinking Water and Water Catchment Safety By-Laws" for the Na-ula Pradeshiya Sabha. It establishes new regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements for water safety, including specific prohibitions and licensing requirements. The content focuses on creating legal/regulatory instruments (by-laws) under statutory authority rather than government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories.
